inputs.notes: Exact versions in use — not a supported range. The .NET target and the DevExpress version the build actually resolves, read from this project's manifests and from the toolchain on the machine that runs validation.
Which documentation source is authoritative for this stack, and which must not be consulted for it. Recorded in mcp/source-routing.md.

Which DevExpress feed the build restores from, how it is authenticated on the build machine, and whether the licence covers this project's use. A build that cannot restore DevExpress packages is not a build, and this is not derivable from the repository.
What counts as one feature in this codebase, and what a feature may touch.
The exact build, test and lint commands, and what their failure looks like. A command nobody has run is not a validation profile.
Whether this stack's material may appear in a public repository. DevExpress material is licensed, which makes this a narrower question here than in an open-source stack.
